explication: SkillDeck is a macOS desktop app for managing skills across AI coding agents. Users browse a registry or select GitHub/local content, install skills, and assign them to agents; the app parses SKILL.md, stores canonical skill directories on disk, and exposes installations through symlinks. The dashboard also supports editing, update checks, and automatic refresh when CLI-side files change. The README documents these capabilities and the MVVM flow; sampled source confirms key orchestration and parsing responsibilities, but not every service call.
